_comment: Scope rules and role split for experiments/procurement/build_pool.py. category_whitelist: 標的分類 code prefixes as strings ("452" = that code only, "45" = every code under 45); empty = all goods categories. amount_tiers: allowed 採購金額級距 values, e.g. "未達公告金額"; empty = any. budget_min / budget_max: NT$ bounds on 預算金額, null = open. Freezing: set frozen to true, run build_pool, then fetch_awards manifest; from then on build_pool refuses to run if this file differs from the hash in MANIFEST.json.
